add_preset.title: New preset
add_preset.description: Choose the valves this preset keeps active. The others stay closed.

edit_preset_details.title: Edit preset
edit_preset_details.description: Change the name or the valves this preset keeps active.

sort_presets.title: Preset order
sort_presets.description:
Current order: {order}

Choose the preset to move and the position it should have (1 = first).

add_slot.title: New time slot
add_slot.description: During these hours the thermostat in Auto mode uses the comfort temperature, outside it uses the reduced one. With a physical thermostat, heating is only allowed inside the slots and stays off outside. If the end is before the start, the slot crosses midnight.

edit_slot_details.title: Edit time slot
edit_slot_details.description: Change the days or the times. If the end is before the start, the slot crosses midnight.

error.invalid_time: Start and end cannot be the same

abort.no_presets: There are no presets to edit or delete
abort.no_slots: There are no slots to edit or delete

same_time.message: Start and end cannot be the same

select_slot_first.message: Select the slot to delete first

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces all the time slots of the thermostat.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: List of slots: days (mon…sun), start and end (HH:MM). An end equal to 00:00 means midnight.
